title: Find all cards that have German foreign flavor text containing the phrase '
question: Find all cards that have German foreign flavor text containing the phrase 'perfekte Gegenmittel' and belong to a set that has a Simplified Chinese translation. Return the card’s English name, artist, set code, and the German flavor text. Order results by card name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c."XCL_049", c."XCL_002", c."XCL_063", f."XCL_076"
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS f ON c."XCL_072" = f."XCL_082"
INNER JOIN set_translations AS st ON c."XCL_063" = st."XCL_093"
WHERE f."XCL_077" = 'German'
  AND f."XCL_076" LIKE '%perfekte Gegenmittel%'
  AND st."XCL_092" = 'Chinese Simplified'
ORDER BY c."XCL_049"
